## What's new

- **A README with pictures.** The project page now shows Dowlio's four main screens — the Library, a YouTube video, a Playlist and Settings — alongside the menu bar panel. It walks through installing from the DMG, what Dowlio downloads, Dowlio Connect and what Dowlio stores.
- **A toolbar that always fits.** The Library window no longer narrows past 840 points, so every button stays on the toolbar while the title shows the download count and speed.

## Before you update

- **Allow the keychain prompt.** After this update, macOS asks once whether Dowlio may read its saved browser pairings. Choose Always Allow. Your browsers stay paired.
